verdict.rationale: First-party docs say plugins use MCP to expose server-backed capabilities to ChatGPT and Codex, that a plugin can bundle MCP servers (including remote MCP-only plugins), that `@plugin-creator` wires up MCP servers, and that installed plugins add MCP tools to new sessions. MCP servers can therefore be plugged in, packaged as plugins, and their tools used. Missing for 10: documented direct configuration of an arbitrary MCP server outside plugin packaging, details on transports and auth for local versus remote servers, and independent hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use through plugins.
